create_aloha_embodiment: create an AlohaEmbodiment instance connected to a robot server on localhost port 8888
create_event_streams: create camera event streams for overhead, left wrist, right wrist, and worms-eye views
run_robot_instruction: run a natural language instruction on the robot like pick up cup or place on table
create_robot_tools: create robot control tools for reset, stop, open gripper, and sleep operations
reset_robot: reset the robot to its default starting position using the robot_reset tool
